purpose: Repair the discovered mismatch between the V74 fit-train group design and the actually available target-unseen validation groups. Recalibrate the unchanged 32-query physical, morphology, and maximum-energy rules using group-count and quota patterns that exactly match a target-free fresh partition, verify a conservative full-gate attainability lower bound after adding V76, and stop before candidate construction or fresh payload access.

V74_fit_train_grouping.Swift: twenty realizations with quotas twelve times 2 and eight times 1

available_fresh_grouping_after_excluding.TNG100: four x-z quadrants with available counts [6,25,20,10]

discovered_compatibility_gap.finding: No domain can execute the exact V74 32-query group design: TNG quadrant 0 contains only six untouched objects, and SIMBA/Swift expose three/seven rather than eight/twenty fresh realizations.
discovered_compatibility_gap.consequence: V74 establishes that 32 queries can be sufficient under its fit-train group design, but cannot by itself establish attainability for the actual fresh partition. A compatible-design audit is required before a complete gate can be frozen.

metadata_accessed: validation dataset shapes and root attributes
metadata_only_selection.old_V72_stage_B: permanently remains forbidden as V72; its never-opened objects return to the untouched pool and may be assigned under this separately frozen program
metadata_only_selection.quota_assignment: TNG group 0 uses all six and the one 8-object group among groups 1-3 is selected by the same salt with purpose quota8; Swift's four 5-object groups are selected by the same salt with purpose quota5; all other quotas are fixed below
metadata_only_selection.selection_role: reserved target-unseen single-use screen only; payload access remains forbidden until a candidate and complete gate implementation are separately frozen and explicitly approved

compatible_fit_train_oracle_design.oracle: For each query, draw sixteen donors with replacement from the same fit-train group after excluding all 32 query indices in the trial; retain duplicates.
compatible_fit_train_oracle_design.TNG100: randomly permute quota multiset [6,8,9,9] over all four fit-train quadrants each trial
compatible_fit_train_oracle_design.SIMBA: choose three of eight fit-train realizations without replacement and randomly permute quotas [7,10,15] over them each trial
compatible_fit_train_oracle_design.Swift: choose seven of twenty fit-train realizations without replacement, randomly designate four for quota 5 and use quota 4 for the remaining three
compatible_fit_train_oracle_design.reason_for_group_randomization: The fresh realization labels are disjoint from fit-train labels. Random subset/permutation auditing measures the group-count and quota design without post-hoc choosing a favorable fit-train analogue.

unchanged_physical_and_morphology_gate.q99_999: absolute pooled generated-minus-truth log10rho q99.999 difference <=0.1 dex in every domain
unchanged_physical_and_morphology_gate.Q4: pooled generated-over-truth mean delta-squared ratio in [2/3,1.5] in every domain
unchanged_physical_and_morphology_gate.high_k_power: mean generated-over-truth log-density power in [0.9,1.1] in both 3-6 and 6-10.0531 h/Mpc bands in every domain
unchanged_physical_and_morphology_gate.residual_RMS: generated own-centered residual RMS over query residual RMS in [0.9,1.1] in every domain
unchanged_physical_and_morphology_gate.density_PDF: generated-query histogram TV strictly lower than deterministic-query histogram TV in every domain
unchanged_physical_and_morphology_gate.two_point: generated-query KS strictly lower than deterministic-query KS in each 0-1, 1-3, and 3-10 Mpc/h mean in every domain
unchanged_physical_and_morphology_gate.environment: every frozen generated mean peak/void statistic has strictly smaller absolute error than the deterministic query mean in every domain

physical_morphology_attainability.report: verification probability and two-sided Wilson 95-percent interval for every component, domain absolute core, domain joint, and aligned all-three-domain joint
pass_if: aligned all-three-domain joint Wilson lower bound >=0.8
every single-domain absolute-core Wilson lower bound >=0.8

maximum_energy_recalibration.statistic: mean query-wise candidate-minus-paired-control unbiased scalar maximum-energy score
maximum_energy_recalibration.prospective_rule: candidate-minus-control mean must not exceed the compatible-design domain margin
maximum_energy_recalibration.calibrated_if: verification three-domain family false-rejection point probability <=0.06 and Wilson upper <=0.065

conservative_complete_gate_attainability.physical_morphology_failure_upper: 1 minus the aligned physical/morphology Wilson lower bound
conservative_complete_gate_attainability.energy_failure_upper: the compatible-design energy family false-rejection Wilson upper bound
conservative_complete_gate_attainability.union_bound_pass_lower: 1 minus the sum of the three failure uppers, floored at zero
conservative_complete_gate_attainability.interpretation: This is a conservative attainability guarantee for the conjunction, not a claim that the complete gate is a single family-wise-alpha-0.05 hypothesis test.

compatible_design_sufficient_if_all: fresh metadata selection has 32 unique untouched indices per domain and exact frozen quotas
predeclared_decision.if_selected_next: Freeze the complete candidate-agnostic V78 gate implementation and await explicit approval before constructing a candidate or reading any selected payload.
predeclared_decision.if_failed_next: Stop before a complete gate or candidate and report the failed frozen requirement.

resource_and_execution.cpu_policy: one process pinned to logical CPU 64 at nice 15
